response.rationale: The item is footwear (not electronics), not final sale, and delivered 10 days ago (within the 30-day standard window). RET-007 applies with the standard return window. No higher-priority rule applies: final_sale is false (RET-012 does not apply), defective is null (RET-020 does not apply), and there is no goodwill grant or fraud hold. Therefore the return is eligible for a full refund.
